From Weather Report · Price: it needs open sky for anything beyond fog.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 2 actions: fog in a @Template[burst|distance:15]{15-ft burst} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{concealed}) for 1 minute, or calm the wind.
  • 5: Surge, outdoors: rain or wind in a @Template[burst|distance:30]{30-ft burst} for 1 minute: difficult terrain, ranged attacks –2.
  • 9: Surge, outdoors: lightning strike on one creature: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[electricity]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 13: Pull moisture from a creature's surroundings: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates), once per creature per day.
  • 17: Once per day, outdoors: heavy weather for 1 minute: every non-ally creature in 60 ft attempts @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} each round or is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} (incapacitation).

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.cB3MERInqYODgMJQ]{Effect: Storm Weather}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
